title: Great Wall space se dikhti hai? MYTH!
source: NASA · Scientific American · Britannica · Al Jazeera

captions.instagram:
NASA ne saaf bol diya: Great Wall space se aapko nahi dikhegi 🧱🚀

🚀 China ke pehle astronaut Yang Liwei ko 2003 mein Great Wall dikhi hi nahi. NASA bhi kehta hai: sirf aankhon se, space se aam taur par nahi dikhti, aur chaand se bilkul nahi. Jo photo hai, woh 400mm zoom lens se li gayi thi!

Sources: NASA, Scientific American, Britannica, Al Jazeera.
Photo: NASA, ISS010-E-08497 (Public domain).

Comment karo: aapne school mein ye padha tha? 👇

Source: NASA · Scientific American · Britannica · Al Jazeera
Facts checked:
• The popular claim: the Great Wall is visible from space; it was even in textbooks — Scientific American; Al Jazeera
• NASA: generally not visible to the unaided eye from low Earth orbit, and not from the Moon — NASA
• The wall is only about 6 m wide and blends with the land's colours — Al Jazeera; Britannica
• Yang Liwei (Shenzhou 5, 2003), China's first astronaut, said he did not see the Great Wall — Al Jazeera; Wikipedia (Shenzhou 5)
• ISS photo ISS010-E-08497 (2004) was taken with a 400 mm lens; only a small section of wall is visible — NASA Image Library
• Cities and roads are visible from low Earth orbit — NASA; Live Science
